id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multi-master single-channel shared serial bus; multidrop wired-AND with bitwise IDENTIFIER arbitration.

supported_topologies.name: Linear bus (typical automotive)
supported_topologies.description: All CAN nodes tap onto a single twisted-pair or single-wire+ground line; terminated at both ends in high-speed ISO 11898-2.

supported_topologies.name: Star / branched (low-speed)
supported_topologies.description: ISO 11898-3 fault-tolerant low-speed CAN allows branched topology (typical body electronics).

supported_topologies.name: Optical fibre
supported_topologies.description: Spec permits optical realization at physical layer (intentionally not detailed).

supported_topologies.name: Sleep / wake-up network
supported_topologies.description: Sleeping nodes are woken by special wake-up message with dedicated lowest-priority identifier.

master_slave_role_summary.description: A unit originating a message; stays transmitter until bus idle or arbitration is lost.
A unit that is not transmitter and the bus is not idle.
Normal operation; sends ACTIVE ERROR FLAGs.
Degraded operation; sends only PASSIVE ERROR FLAGs; adds SUSPEND TRANSMISSION after own messages.
Not allowed to influence the bus; output drivers off.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The bus is a flat shared medium; any node can transmit when the bus is idle, and bitwise arbitration on IDENTIFIER resolves contention without information loss.

ordering_guarantees.single_bus: All nodes simultaneously see the same bus value (modulo signal propagation); data consistency = a message is accepted by all receivers or by none.
ordering_guarantees.arbitration: Higher-priority messages (lower IDENTIFIER value) are transmitted first; no fairness guarantee for equal-priority messages — re-arbitration each time.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — CAN is wire-level. Per-controller mailbox / FIFO / acceptance-filter register maps live in the SoC integration spec.

slave_classification.addressable_target: Not applicable — CAN is content-addressed, not destination-addressed. All nodes see every frame; MESSAGE FILTERING happens locally on the IDENTIFIER.
slave_classification.data_producer: Any node may transmit DATA FRAMEs with one or more IDENTIFIERs.
slave_classification.data_consumer: Any node may apply MESSAGE FILTERING to accept matching IDENTIFIERs.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: Section 3 Message Transfer — frame types and fields
Section 7 Fault Confinement — error count rules + state transitions

wake_up_topology.wake_up_trigger: Any bus activity (dominant edge) or internal condition.
wake_up_topology.wake_up_message: Dedicated identifier 'rrr rrrd rrrr' — lowest possible priority; intended to lose arbitration to anything else.
wake_up_topology.post_wake_sync: Transfer layer waits for oscillator stabilization + 11 consecutive recessive bits before re-enabling bus drivers.
